Yes, the 30-day evaluation cycle is stricter than what is required by Part 2.2.

The requirement in CIP-007-6 R2 Part 2.2 allows for an evaluation frequency of "At least once every 35 calendar days" [csection-7700dd5499cead0994ec]. The operator's recorded decision states, "We evaluate patches every 30 days, not the 35 the Part allows, because our change window is monthly and a 35-day clock straddles two windows" [csection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3].
